en.headline: Police arrest two drivers over cross-border illegal passenger services
en.dek: Officers posing as passengers booked luxury seven-seaters via social media for trips to Shenzhen, leading to the arrest of a 33-year-old local man and a 27-year-old mainland man on a two-way permit.
body: Police from the Hong Kong Island Regional Traffic Headquarters conducted an undercover operation on Tuesday against illegal cross-border passenger services known as white-plate cars, arresting two drivers.

According to police, officers identified intermediaries advertising luxury seven-seater services on social media platforms offering transport from Hong Kong to cities in the mainland via land border crossings. Posing as passengers seeking rides to Shenzhen, they were quoted HK$950 and HK$1,050 respectively, with full payment required in advance to designated electronic wallets.

After making the payments, the officers boarded two Hong Kong-registered vehicles with dual plates. The drivers, a 33-year-old local man and a 27-year-old mainland man holding a two-way permit, were arrested on suspicion of driving for hire without a permit and driving without third-party insurance. The mainland man was also held for alleged breach of conditions of stay.

Police said the local man was released on bail and must report back in late November, while the mainland man was detained for further investigation and is expected to appear in Eastern Magistrates' Court on Wednesday morning. The two vehicles were seized for examination. Officers noted that such operations contribute to congestion at crossings such as Huanggang and reminded the public to use only licensed transport.

zh.headline: 警方放蛇打擊跨境白牌車 拘捕本地及持雙程證司機
zh.dek: 港島總區交通部人員喬裝乘客，經社交平台預約豪華七人車前往深圳，成功拘捕一名33歲本地男子及一名27歲持雙程證內地男子。
body: 警方港島總區交通部星期二採取行動，打擊俗稱白牌車的非法載客取酬活動，拘捕兩名司機。
警方表示，人員近日網絡巡查發現有中介在社交平台招撽乘客，以豪華七人車由香港出發經陸路口岸前往內地城市。人員喬裝乘客查詢前往深圳服務，對方分別開價950元及1050元，並要求預先將全數車費存入指定電子錢包。
人員按指示付款後登上兩輛本港登記、掛有兩地車牌的豪華七人車，隨即表露身份。被捕者分別為33歲本地男子及27歲持雙程證的內地男子，涉嫌非法載客取酬及駕駛時沒有第三者保險；內地男子另涉違反逗留條件。
警方指本地男子已獲准保釋，須於11月下旬報到；內地男子被扣留調查，預計星期三上午在東區裁判法院提堂。兩輛涉案車輛已被扣留檢驗。警方提醒市民應選用合法公共交通工具，切勿光顧非法載客服務，以免保險失效影響保障。
